Desarrollador de Software /
Senior Full-Stack / AI Software Engineer (m/f/d)
------------------------------------------------------------------------

Remoto / Remote | Tiempo parcial (mín. 4 días/semana) o jornada completa / Part-time (min. 4 days/week) or full-time
Cassava Software Engineering S.L. es un socio tecnológico de confianza para diferentes empresas líderes y grupos internacionales en Europa. Para reforzar nuestro equipo buscamos un Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer con experiencia en AI Engineering.
TU RETO
Diseñar, desarrollar y operar aplicaciones web modernas, desde frontend y backend hasta Cloud y DevOps.
Integrar funcionalidades de IA y soluciones agentic utilizando LLMs, Retrieval, Tool Use y workflows estructurados.
Desarrollar servicios cloud-native seguros, fiables y escalables.
Participar en el desarrollo de AI Agents, Skills, Pipelines y Workflows.
Colaborar con Product Management, UX, Arquitectura y otros Engineers.
Crear soluciones con valor real para los usuarios, especialmente en el sector sanitario.
TU PERFIL
Imprescindible:
Varios años de experiencia senior como Full-Stack Engineer.
Experiencia sólida con React o Angular y Java/Spring Boot o Python.
Buenos conocimientos de Kubernetes, Helm, ArgoCD y Terraform.
Experiencia demostrable utilizando IA en el desarrollo de software.
Titulación en Informática, Software Engineering o equivalente.
Capacidad de resolución de problemas, iniciativa y orientación a resultados.
Valorable: experiencia con AI Coding Agents, AI Pipelines, Harnesses, Context Engineering, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic SDK o MCP, así como experiencia en Healthcare.
TE OFRECEMOS
100 % trabajo remoto
Desde 4 días/semana o jornada completa
Proyectos internacionales con empresas líderes
Tecnologías modernas de AI y Software Engineering
Alto grado de autonomía y responsabilidad técnica

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Cassava Software Engineering S.L. is a trusted technology partner for leading companies and international groups across Europe. To strengthen our team, we are looking for a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer with strong AI Engineering experience.
YOUR CHALLENGE
Design, develop and operate modern web applications across frontend, backend, Cloud and DevOps.
Integrate AI-native features and agentic solutions using LLMs, Retrieval, Tool Use and structured workflows.
Build reliable, secure and scalable cloud-native services.
Contribute to shared AI Agents, Skills, Pipelines and Workflows.
Work closely with Product Management, UX, Architects and Engineers.
Develop solutions delivering real value, particularly in the healthcare sector.

YOUR PROFILE
Must-have:
Several years of senior Full-Stack Engineering experience.
Strong experience with React or Angular and Java/Spring Boot or Python.
Solid knowledge of Kubernetes, Helm, ArgoCD and Terraform.
Proven and effective use of AI in software development.
Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or equivalent.
Strong problem-solving skills, initiative and results-oriented mindset.
Nice to have: experience with AI Coding Agents, AI Pipelines, Harnesses, Context Engineering, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic SDK or MCP, and Healthcare.

WE OFFER
100% remote work
Part-time from 4 days/week or full-time
International projects with leading companies
Modern AI and Software Engineering technologies
High level of autonomy and technical responsibility
